checks.name: provenance_complete
checks.detail: Every record carries source_name, source_page, title and mapping_method.

checks.name: recension_matches_corpus
checks.detail: Every record's recension is the one this corpus holds (RV/SAK, SV/KAU, YV/VSM, AV/SAU).

checks.name: scope_type_matches_key_depth
checks.detail: No record claims a scope its key's depth contradicts.

checks.name: samagana_never_bound_to_arcika_verse
checks.detail: No SAMAGANA record is attached to a passage below WORK scope.

checks.name: one_url_one_passage
checks.detail: No media URL is mapped to more than one passage.

checks.name: one_record_per_passage_per_source
checks.detail: No passage carries two recordings from the same source.

checks.name: strong_mapping_states_evidence
checks.detail: Every EXACT or HIGH mapping records a substantive mapping_method.

checks.name: no_offsets_without_exact_mapping
checks.detail: No record carries verse offsets without an EXACT or HIGH mapping to justify them.

checks.name: exact_mapping_is_text_verified
checks.detail: Every EXACT mapping was confirmed by comparing the recited text with this corpus.

checks.name: tiers_partition_the_catalogue
checks.detail: Every record carries a publication tier and the tiers sum to the catalogue.

checks.name: reviewed_tier_cites_a_real_hearing
checks.detail: Every RELEASED_VERIFIED record is backed by a named listener's decision row, and no SOURCE_MAPPED_UNREVIEWED record claims one.

checks.name: proxied_records_name_their_source_item
checks.detail: Every PROXIED_STREAM record names the source item to fetch.

checks.name: playback_mode_has_its_url
checks.detail: Every playback mode carries the URL it needs.

checks.name: cached_files_exist_inside_root
checks.detail: Every local_cache_path resolves to a real file inside the cache directory.

checks.name: available_records_dated
checks.detail: Every AVAILABLE record carries the date it was measured.

checks.name: no_dangling_passage_identity
checks.detail: All 17780 distinct scope keys exist as Passage nodes.

checks.name: record_veda_matches_key_veda
checks.detail: No record names a Veda its own key does not belong to.

checks.name: scope_type_matches_node_type
checks.detail: Every scope_type is legal for the node type its key resolves to (a SUKTA scope over a HYMN node, never over a MANTRA).

checks.name: coverage_within_corpus_size
checks.detail: No Veda maps more spans than the corpus contains.
